licences.title: Licences
licences.lead: PAX is free software, built on free software. This page states the terms.
licences.pax_body: PAX is distributed under the GNU AGPL-3.0 licence. You may use, study, modify and redistribute it. The “Affero” clause adds one duty the other GPL licences do not have: if you run a modified version on a server open to the public, you must offer its source code to the people using it.
licences.wims_title: The exercises and the OEF format
licences.wims_body: The exercises come from the WIMS project and its community of authors, under the GNU GPL. PAX replays their format (OEF, DEF) and ports their marking logic; it does not replace them. Each exercise keeps its author, named in the module it comes from.
licences.deps_body: The components below make the site work. Some run on the server, others in your browser.
licences.deps_note: Licences taken from each project; recheck them on any major version bump.

manifeste.title: Manifesto
manifeste.lead: Why this project exists, and what it owes to WIMS.
manifeste.pourquoi_body:
Practice needs repetition, and repetition needs questions that change. That is what WIMS has done for thirty years: parameterised exercises, drawn at random, marked automatically, written by teachers for their students.

PAX takes up that principle with today's tools, and asks nothing of anyone: no account needed to practise, no tracker, no reliance on a third-party service.
manifeste.choix_body:
Stay compatible. The thousands of exercises written for WIMS run here without being rewritten — that is the condition for their authors' work to keep serving.

Stay readable. The code explains why it does what it does, above all where it reproduces a WIMS quirk: faithful marking beats elegant marking that gets the answer wrong.

Stay free. Under the AGPL, including for whoever hosts the service.
manifeste.ouvert_body: PAX is a work in progress. Not every exercise type is ported, and some only partly — the repository keeps that count up to date rather than hiding it.
manifeste.merci_body:
To the WIMS team and its authors, who built and maintained a free exercise library for three decades, and documented it well enough that a faithful clone could be written.

PAX is not affiliated with the WIMS project. It is an attentive reader of it.

cgu.title: Terms of use
cgu.lead: What this service offers, and what it expects from you.
cgu.a_completer: To be filled in by whoever runs the site:
cgu.editeur_body:
This site is published in a personal, non-professional capacity by a mathematics teacher. Under article 6 III-2 of French law no. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004, the publisher of a non-professional site may give only the name of its host, their own identifying details being held by that host.

Publication director: the site publisher.
Contact: …

Host: Infomaniak Network SA — Rue Eugène-Marziano 25, 1227 Les Acacias, Geneva, Switzerland. Servers and data are located in Switzerland, a country the European Commission recognises as offering an adequate level of protection.
cgu.objet_body: PAX provides interactive exercises in mathematics and science. Questions are drawn at random on each attempt and marked automatically. The service is provided as is, for teaching purposes.
cgu.acces_body: Exercises can be used without an account. Access may be suspended at any time, in particular for maintenance, without notice or compensation.
cgu.compte_body: An account is required to follow or set homework. Accounts are opened by a teacher or an administrator; there is no open sign-up. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for what is done from your account.
cgu.donnees_body:
Data controller: the site publisher.

Legal basis: legitimate interests (GDPR article 6(1)(f)) — letting students practise and their teacher follow their progress. Once the service is hosted by a school authority or a university, the basis will become the performance of a task carried out in the public interest (article 6(1)(e)) and that institution will be the controller.

Data processed: for an account, a first name, a surname, an email address and a role; for progress tracking, exercise attempts and marks. A teacher may issue identifiers alone, with no real name or address: tracking needs no more than that.

Retention: one year after the last sign-in, then erasure. Attempts and marks are kept for the current school year and the one after. Beyond that they may be kept indefinitely in **anonymised** form for usage statistics: truly anonymous data can no longer be traced back to anyone and falls outside the regulation.

No data is passed to third parties and the site uses no advertising tracker. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection, to be exercised with the contact above. You may also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority (CNIL).

Where the people concerned are minors, these rights are exercised by their legal guardians.
cgu.contenus_body: The exercises come from the WIMS project and its authors. They may contain mistakes, and their automatic marking may be wrong. They are neither a test nor an official assessment.
cgu.propriete_body: The PAX software is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence. The exercises remain under their authors' licence (GPL, WIMS project). See the Licences page.
cgu.responsabilite_body: The service is provided with no warranty of accuracy or availability. The publisher cannot be held liable for the consequences of an error in a question, in marking, or in a grade.
cgu.modification_body: These terms may change. The date of the last update appears at the foot of this page.
